contents.name: Theorem 6.6, Whitney's elimination of opposite intersection pairs, with Lemma 6.7 (pp. 71-79)

contents.reason: The middle-dimensional cancellation theorem uses the Whitney trick and the matrix reduction over a unimodular handle matrix, which this page deliberately leaves to the later Whitney-trick pair.

contents.name: Section 8, elimination of critical points of index 0 and 1 (pp. 96-107)
contents.reason: The 0- and 1-handle elimination argument belongs to the h-cobordism development of this run, not to the elementary-moves page.
